get.description:
Allows to access multiple products by a single request. This convenience resource should be used instead making
 separated requests. This saves bandwidth and CPU time on the server. The URI is the same like requesting a single
 Product by id, but multiple ids wrapped by parentheses and separated can be provided. If a parenthesis or the
 separator is part of the identifier itself it has to be URL encoded. Instead of a single Product document a
 result object of Product documents is returned. Note: Only products that are online and assigned to site catalog
 are returned. The maximum number of ids is 24. If none of the products requested are found, the cache-control header
 will be defaulted to 60 seconds.

parameters.description: The ids of the requested products.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description:
The expand parameter. A comma separated list with the allowed values (availability,
            bundled_products, links, promotions, options, images, prices, variations, set_products, recommendations)
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: the optional inventory list ids, for which the availability should be shown.
parameters.name: inventory_ids

parameters.description: The currency mnemonic specified for price.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The flag that indicates whether to retrieve the whole image model for the requested product.
parameters.name: all_images

get.description:
To access single products resource, you construct a URL using the template shown below. This template requires
 you to specify an Id (typically a SKU) for a product. In response, the server returns a corresponding Product
 document, provided the product is online and assigned to site catalog. The document contains variation attributes
 (including values) and the variant matrix; this data is provided for both the master and for the variant.

This endpoint may return the following faults:


 - 400 - InvalidExpandParameterException - Thrown in case a specified expand parameter value is unknown.

parameters.description: The id of the requested product.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description:
The expand parameter. A comma separated list with the allowed values (availability,
            bundled_products, links, promotions, options, images, prices, variations, set_products, recommendations)
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: the optional inventory list ids, for which the availability should be shown.
parameters.name: inventory_ids

parameters.description: The currency mnemonic specified for price.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The flag that indicates whether to retrieve the whole image model for the requested product.
parameters.name: all_images

Access product link information of products that are online and assigned to site catalog. Filter the result by
 link type and link direction.

This endpoint may return the following faults:

 - 400 - MalformedLinkTypeCodeParameterException - 400 indicates unknown product link type code
 - 404 - ProductNotFoundException - 404 No product with given id found
